uniform_results.compulsory_core: Every endpoint of every q-parallel wall contains C_q=Div(q_plus) union Div(q_minus) minus the two tips.
uniform_results.single_contraction: Rank r=n-nu(q)+1 on E(C_q,r), contained in at most six translates of V_r^3.
uniform_results.local_contraction_scope: Restricted and global support functions agree locally at each q-wall, where both adjacent standard sets contain C_q. Forcing C_q can strictly raise the minimum at other positive weights.
uniform_results.saturated_wall_bound: At most one q-wall when nu(q)=n.
uniform_results.near_saturation_cell_bound: O(n*R^(7/3)*log(n+1)*L_R^2) cells incident to a wall with n-R<nu(q)<=n.
uniform_results.sublinear_example: R=floor(n^(3/4)) gives O(n^(11/4)*log(n+1)^3) for that part of the fan.
uniform_results.near_saturation_wall_cost: V_R=O(n^2*R^(7/3)*log(n+1)*L_R^2); R=floor(n^(3/7)) gives O(n^3*log(n+1)^3) for that part only.
uniform_results.two_sided_cell_localization: O(n^2*log(n+1)^3) cells are incident to a wall with nu(q)<=floor(n^(3/7)) or nu(q)>n-floor(n^(3/7)). A polynomial excess must have every incident cost in the middle.
uniform_results.two_sided_cubic_budget_localization: The portions of V with nu(q)<=floor(n^(3/5)) and nu(q)>n-floor(n^(3/7)) both obey O(n^3*log(n+1)^3). No bound on the complementary middle portion is proved.
uniform_results.arbitrary_planar_embedding: For any length-R planar J, H=(xy,yz,xF,y^(b+1),F-y^b,zJ), with monic F in J, F(0)=0, deg F=a>=R+1 and gcd(a,b)=1, has length a+b+R, g(H)=2*g(J), and p_H(a,-b,0)=g(J). Its initial formula holds for every global order.
uniform_results.superlinear_residual_obstruction: Planar generic ideals give p_H(q)=Theta(r*log(r+1)), r=R+1; a=R^2+1, b=R^2+2 makes n-nu(q)=R while n=Theta(R^2). Thus a uniform O(r) parallel-wall bound is false.

scope: Uniform proofs use the fixed compulsory monomial core, a relative divisor cover, one rank-preserving matroid contraction, the published Dey bound and the translated arithmetic shadow estimate. The tagged construction embeds every planar fan over every field; its superlinear residual lower family uses the established rational generic planar count. Whole embedded cones are checked independently from quotient columns, including local, nonlocal and characteristic-dependent cases. The middle collective cost budget, an improved unrestricted exponent and exact priority remain unproved.
